321: And this lulav [palm branch] is the righteous one. For it is similar to the spinal cord, which has eighteen rings corresponding to the eighteen wavings of the lulav. And those correspond to the eighteen blessings of prayer, corresponding to the eighteen mentions [of God] of Give to the Lord, O sons of powers (Psalms 29:1), corresponding to the eighteen mentions in the recitation of Shema. So he waves it in the six directions, the total of six, three wavings to each side, is eighteen.
